tool.t015: The official lightweight item reader is a quick alternative when you only need floor-item details and minimap locations. Installation takes just a few clicks, and the forum post includes the latest download and update notes.
tool.t018: I made this tool to smooth out as many of PSOBB's pain points as possible and make the game more enjoyable to play.
tool.t019: psobb-tools is based on the structure of RPAS - a huge thank you to Roland, who has since retired. Your work made this possible.
tool.t025: Holding a number key makes it auto-repeat. Every key (0~9 number row & Numpad 0~9) has its own individual delay you can customize.
tool.t033: You need to try it in front of the NPC that creates rooms.
tool.t034: Creates a room automatically with your preset name, password, and difficulty. A counter in the top-right shows how many rooms you've made this session.
tool.t040: Instantly switch between equipment slots without opening menus manually.
tool.t048: Change your Section ID instantly using
tool.t052: Send frequently used chat commands with a single keystroke.
tool.t057: Remaps several awkward default keys to something more ergonomic.
tool.t078: Rooms you create with the room shortcuts are now counted for you. The overlay parks itself in the top-right corner of the game window and keeps a separate tally for EP1, EP2 and EP4, so you can farm a run without keeping score in your head.
tool.t079: PSOBB Room Counter overlay showing per-episode counts, an opacity slider and reset buttons
tool.t082: Run PSOBB-Tools.exe from your PSO folder and allow the admin prompt. The hotkey only fires while the PHANTASY STAR ONLINE Blue Burst window is active.
tool.t083: Press Win + Numpad0 in-game to show or hide the counter. The tray icon carries the same toggle under Show/Hide Room Counter.
tool.t084: Create rooms the usual way with Win + Numpad4 (EP1), Win + Numpad5 (EP2) or Win + Numpad6 (EP4). Each room adds +1 to that episode on its own - there is nothing extra to press.
tool.t085: Every count also flashes as a small EP badge in the top-right of the game window for two seconds, so you can confirm a room registered without opening the window at all.
tool.t087: is your run counter. It moves only when you create a room or press Reset Current, so you can keep one farming session in it.
tool.t088: is a daily tally. It clears itself the moment the date changes, so you never reset it by hand.
tool.t089: adds EP1, EP2 and EP4 together for each column.
tool.t090: sets the window between 30% and 100%. The value saves the instant you move the slider, and the flash badge uses it too.
tool.t091: keeps the overlay on screen and brings it back a few seconds after the script starts. Press it to switch to OFF and the overlay hides itself five seconds later.
tool.t092: takes back the newest +1 - handy when a room creation misfires. It remembers a single step, so use it right away.
tool.t093: each zero out only their own column.
